query:
SELECT p.id, p.residentId, r.firstName, r.lastName, p.totalHours, p.usedHours, p.deductedMinutes, p.isActive, p.startDate, p.endDate 
FROM packages p 
JOIN residents r ON p.residentId = r.id 
WHERE r.firstName LIKE '%enka%' OR r.lastName LIKE '%enka%';
